notes: 15 is every slot filled at its least: 1 opening + 1 band + 3 column pictures + 4 strip + 6 pile. Below 15 the pile goes first (under 6 to spare), then the strip (under 4). photos_large_min is 0 because balamo, with nothing 1600 px wide, fills the opening and the band; what is needed instead is the two sizes listed under needs. Dish squares of 600 px fill every card, strip and pile frame without enlarging. A menu with sections whose pages carry dish pictures (photo.page = section.h) adds one picture per section; priced dishes take a picture when its file name matches the dish's address. The reference's wheel of cut-outs, the cut-out cup and the falling 3D bagels are not part of this build: cut-outs are not needed and would not be used.
needs (as written): place.spaces or steps.items (3, each with a picture or a link to a page that has one)
needs (as written): one photograph of the room or outside, not small, at least 1152 x 720 (the opening)
drops (as written): trust (unless there is neither menu nor cuisine)
drops (as written): links beyond the first three rows
drops (as written): plans (the reference, a bagel shop's home page, has no tiers or subscriptions; its priced things are its menu, which is shown)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (no made pictures: places)
